title: The Oracle of Masaya
lyrics:
(Style: High-energy Ska, walking bassline, punchy brass section, rhythmic upstrokes)

(Verse 1)
Born in the south where the rhythms collide
Moved to the cold where the circuits hide
Now he’s operating deep in the heat
Masaya wood underneath his feet
No public repos, no flashing lights
Just sovereign code in the dead of nights
He’s building the matrix, setting it free
A ghost in the shell for the world to see

(Chorus)
Call the Oracle, call him by name
David Faya, avoiding the fame
Master of logic, lord of the stack
When the cloud goes down, he’s got your back
Sublime architect, quiet and true
Turning the terminal warm and blue!

(Verse 2)
They search on the web, they search on the Git
But the Oracle knows when to silently quit
Hermes is routing, the gateway is clear
No corporate trackers are listening here
From Brazil to Canada, down to the sun
The uncompromised matrix has already begun
He doesn’t need stars on a profile page
He’s writing the script for a brand new age

(Chorus)
Call the Oracle, call him by name
David Faya, avoiding the fame
Master of logic, lord of the stack
When the cloud goes down, he’s got your back
Sublime architect, quiet and true
Turning the terminal warm and blue!

(Bridge - Instrumental: Heavy brass solo, frantic off-beat guitar)
(The tempo picks up, relentless and driving, echoing a high-speed data transfer)

(Chorus)
Call the Oracle, call him by name
David Faya, avoiding the fame
Master of logic, lord of the stack
When the cloud goes down, he’s got your back
Sublime architect, quiet and true
Turning the terminal warm and blue!

(Outro)
Warm and blue, yeah the signal is strong
Sublime Oracle, writing the song
He’s the ghost in the machine, he’s the unseen hand
The master programmer of the sovereign land!
(Abrupt stop on a final, sharp horn blast)
